tools.name: live_control_panel.py
tools.purpose: Windows-friendly launcher and monitor for the read-only live stack.
tools.input: latest telemetry session, compact live packets
tools.output: local helper processes and bounded GUI logs

tools.name: check_live_setup.py
tools.purpose: Preflight check for compact packets, live output files, navigation packets, and recording mode.

tools.name: inspect_live_packets.py
tools.purpose: Validate and summarize compact live NDJSON packet segments.
tools.output: packet counts, latest tick, segment and retention summary

tools.name: live_target_processor.py
tools.purpose: Consumes compact packets and writes rolling live context files.
tools.input: compact live packets or raw ticks when explicitly requested

tools.name: context_service.py
tools.purpose: Local read-only request/response API for context_request.v1.

tools.name: live_context_query.py
tools.purpose: Human dashboard, event timeline, and context query helper.

tools.name: target_geometry_inspector.py
tools.purpose: Browser-based visual QA for live or recorded target geometry.
tools.input: session folder or rolling live files

tools.name: diagnose_overlay_state.py
tools.purpose: Compare RuneLite overlay debug state to live candidate/context files.

tools.name: run_target_geometry_pipeline.py
tools.purpose: Batch target geometry pipeline for full debug/audit sessions.
tools.output: world/UI target geometry and inspector artifacts

tools.name: build_world_target_geometry.py
tools.purpose: Build world target geometry from raw/debug session data.

tools.name: build_ui_target_geometry.py
tools.purpose: Build UI target geometry from raw/debug session data.

tools.name: select_target_candidates.py
tools.purpose: Select target candidates from batch geometry outputs.

tools.name: telemetry_launcher.py
tools.purpose: Older launcher retained for compatibility; live_control_panel.py is the daily launcher.
